In 2006, she won a gold medal at the Venus Women’s Box Cup in Denmark and won gold again at the AIBA Women’s World Boxing Championship in India.

questions.question: Who among the following is NOT a hockey player?
questions.questionHtml: Who among the following is NOT a hockey player?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Manu Bhaker.

Key Points

  • Manu Bhaker is NOT a hockey player.
  • Manu Bhaker:
    • She is an Olympian from India who competes in airgun shooting.
    • She earned two gold medals for India at the 2018 ISSF World Cup.
    • She is the youngest Indian to earn an ISSF World Cup gold medal.
    • In her first Commonwealth Games debut, she won the gold medal in the women's 10 m air pistol event at the age of 16.
    • She qualified for the finals after scoring 388/400 points in the women's 10m air pistol qualification round at the 2018 Commonwealth Games.
    • She won the gold medal in the women's 10m air pistol event at the Gold Coast Commonwealth Games by establishing a new Commonwealth Games record of 240.9 points in the final round.

Additional Information

  • The Indian hockey team won a gold medal at the Amsterdam Olympics in 1928 against the Netherlands.
  • Jaipal Singh was the captain of the Indian hockey team at that time.
  • Dhyanchand scored the highest number of goals (14) at the 1928 Olympics.
  • Indian hockey team won the Gold medals in six consecutive Summer Olympics starting in 1928, 32, 36, 48, 52, and 56, and then two times later in 1964 and 1980.
  • Indian Hockey Team under the leadership of Manpreet Singh has also qualified for the Tokyo Olympics.
  • Deepika Thakur, Akashdeep Singh, and Ajit Singh all are Hockey players.

Important Points 

Manu Bhaker won two bronze medals at the 2024 Paris Olympics in shooting, making her the first Indian woman to win an Olympic medal in shooting: 

  • Women's 10 metre air pistol: Bhaker's first medal and India's first medal at the 2024 Paris Olympics 
  • Mixed 10 metre air pistol team event: Bhaker won this bronze medal with Sarabjot Singh, beating the Republic of Korea 
  • Bhaker was also the flagbearer for India at the closing ceremony of the 2024 Paris Olympics. Her next goal is to win a gold medal at the 2028 LA Olympics

questions.question: Who among the following is a professional Indian gymnast?

questions.question: ________ took a hat-trick (three wickets) in the first over of the match against Pakistan in 2006, becoming the first and, to date, the only bowler to do so.
questions.questionHtml: ________ took a hat-trick (three wickets) in the first over of the match against Pakistan in 2006, becoming the first and, to date, the only bowler to do so.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 3 i.e. Irfan Pathan

  • Irfan Pathan is the first bowler who takes a hat-trick in the "first over" of the test match.
  • Irfan Pathan became the second Indian bowler to take a hat-trick in the test match.
  • Irfan Pathan takes this great achievement against Pakistan in the third Test of the three-match series on January 29, 2006.
  • Off-spinner Harbhajan Singh is the first Indian bowler to achieve Test hat-trick.
  • Jasprit Bumrah became the third Indian bowler who takes a Test hat-trick.

questions.question: Who is the first Indian to have won an individual Olympic gold medal?
questions.questionHtml: Who is the first Indian to have won an individual Olympic gold medal?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Abhinav Bindra.

Key Points

  • Abhinav Bindra collects the gold medal for India in the men's 10m air rifle shooting competition.
  • Bindra captures India's first individual gold medal in Shooting 10m Air Rifle Final Men - Beijing.

Important Points

  • At the Sydney 2000 Olympic Games, weightlifter Karnam Malleswari marked her place in Olympic and Indian sports history.
  • She took the bronze medal and became India’s first woman to win an Olympic medal.
  • Leander Paes is an Indian tennis player who was one of the most successful doubles players in tennis history,
    • With 8 career Grand Slam doubles titles and 10 career Grand Slam mixed doubles championships.
    • In 1996 when he took the men’s singles tennis bronze medal at the Atlanta Olympic Games, he became the first Indian athlete since 1952 to win an individual Olympic medal.
  • PV Sindhu defeated He Bing Jiao in straight games to clinch the bronze medal at the Tokyo Games and become the first Indian woman to win two individual Olympic medals.
  • After becoming the first Indian female athlete to win a Silver medal at the Olympics in Rio in 2016 PV Sindhu has become only the 2nd Indian athlete after Sushil Kumar to win 2 individual medals at the Games.
  • PV Sindhu: Achievements
    • In January 2020, PV Sindhu was awarded the Third-Highest Civilian Award in India- Padma Bhushan.
    • In March 2015, Sindhu was awarded the Fourth Highest Civilian Award in India- Padma Shri. 
    • In August 2016, she was awarded the Highest Sporting Honour of India- Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna.
    • In September 2013, PV Sindhu was awarded the Arjuna Award for outstanding performance in sports. etc.

questions.question: Pankaj Advani is associated with which sports?
questions.questionHtml: Pankaj Advani is associated with which sports?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Billiards.

Key Points

  • Pankaj Arjan Advani is an Indian professional snooker and  billiards (pool) player who was born on July 24, 1985.
  • He is a 27-time world champion in the International Billiards and Snooker Federation (IBSF).
  • He has won eighteen world championships in pool, seventeen IBSF World Billiards Championships, and one World Team Billiards Championship.
  • He has the record number of IBSF world championships.
  • He became a snooker professional in 2012/2013.
  • The Government of India has given Advani multiple accolades in acknowledgment of his accomplishments: the Padma Shri in 2009, the Arjuna Award in 2004, the Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2006, and the Padma Bhushan in 2018.

questions.question: Leander Paes is associated with ________.
questions.questionHtml: Leander Paes is associated with ________.
questions.solution: Leander Paes is a renowned Indian tennis player known for his exceptional skills in doubles and mixed doubles. He has won 18 Grand Slam titles, making him one of the greatest doubles players in tennis history. Paes has represented India in numerous Olympic Games and has significantly promoted tennis in the country. His achievements have brought immense pride to India and inspired many young athletes to pursue tennis professionally. He was awarded the Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna in 1996-97, the Padma Shri in 2001, and the Padma Bhushan in 2014 for his contributions to Indian sports.
